# Formal-kind/access first observations

Prepared and unexecuted by this author. Ten frozen candidate sources are copied
exactly into independent `attempt-01/<case>/main.qli` projects with the existing
schema-2 edition2026 manifest. Original candidate bytes stay untouched. The
context, session.before.json, project-inputs.json and commands-before.json record
the complete mapping before execution; no recorded argv is executed.

The fixed driver authors forty bounded CLI checks: finite text/JSON, then
selected explicit `main::main` auto-profile text/JSON for each literal case.
It uses the existing CLI `db571ad2…` and native checker `39effde0…`; file identity
is not compiled-source or running-image attestation. The exact previously
reviewed multi-call `common-parameter-declaration-v030/native-log.py` is reused,
along with the frozen bounded streaming helper. The QFT single-call forwarder
is unsuitable here because it excludes finite modes and refuses multiple calls.

Root reviews the frozen FIRST map and then supplies its actual observed hash:

```sh
python3 tests/fixtures/authoring_sessions/common-formal-access-v030/driver.py --first-files-sha256 REVIEWED_FIRST_FILES_SHA
```

The one-shot `before/` directory retains raw stdout/stderr, literal argv, real
CLI capture status and native argv JSONL. Journal rows count actual forwarded
invocation attempts immediately before execv; they do not independently attest
native process starts or child exits. Events include the actual decoded JSON
result when present and a labelled bounded text transcript; exact raw captured
byte prefixes remain separate. Outcomes are not predicted or repaired.
Only after forty complete operational captures is session.json added; the
unobserved session remains immutable. Nonzero source-check exits are data.

Each outer capture has a 55-second budget and 1 MiB stdout/stderr caps; every
regular file written by collector/descendants has a maximum 1 MiB operational
ceiling (or a smaller existing ceiling). This bounds the append-only journal as
well. These are harness limits, not changes to type/kernel/program resource
rules. A timeout/output/launch failure preserves partial records and stops,
without inventing a child exit or retrying. The streaming helper kills its
outer process group; separate Rust/native groups are not an attested complete
descendant tree. No guarantee of descendant cleanup follows from those logs.

Every command guards candidate/project/driver/helper bytes, source inventories,
all production Rust/kernel/std inputs selected by identity-prepared.json,
Cargo/Lean metadata, constitutional records and observed CLI/native hashes.
This declared file subset does not prove complete runtime/build closure.
The driver adds no production, original-fixture, book, Issue or authority change.
